summary: Aloysius Pieris was a scholar in religious and Buddhist studies. He studied under Bernard de Give and earned degrees from several institutions, including London, Sri Lanka, and Tilburg. In 1974, he founded and directed the Tulana Research Centre.
Alubomulle Sumanasara is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Yasuaki Nara at Komazawa University from circa 1980 to 1988.

Alva Noë is a philosopher who studied at the University of Oxford and Harvard University. His academic career includes faculty positions at the University of California, Santa Cruz (~1996-2003), UC Berkeley (~2003), and the City University of New York.

Alvappillai Veluppillai was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Peradeniya and University of Oxford under Thomas Burrow. He held posts at Peradeniya, Jaffna, Uppsala University, and was Professor of Religious Studies at Arizona State University.

Amalananda Ghosh was an archaeologist and Indologist who studied at University College London. He served as Director General of Archæology in India at the Archaeological Survey of India (1937-1968), as a UNESCO adviser, and as an IIAS Fellow.
Amalia Pezzali is a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who studied under T. R. V. Murti and Michel Hulin.

Amanda K. Goodman is a scholar in Buddhist studies and sinology. She earned her Ph.D. at the University of California, Berkeley, under Robert H. Sharf, Luis Oscar Gómez, and Donald S. Lopez, Jr., and holds a teaching position at the University of Toronto.
Amar Nath Pandeya is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who held positions at the University of Delhi (attested 1968) and Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith (attested 1987).

Amar Singh is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and history and archaeology. He studied under Anthony Kennedy Warder, Bimal Krishna Matilal, T. Venkatacharya, Alasdair Urquhart, and Rahul Sankrityayan.

Amaranatha Jha was an academic who studied at Muir Central College, where he was appointed Professor of English in 1917. He later served as Vice-Chancellor of the University of Allahabad (~1938-1946) and Banaras Hindu University (~1947-1948).
Amarasvar Thakur was an Indologist who held a post at the University of Calcutta (attested 1936) and served as General Editor for the Calcutta Sanskrit Series.

Amartya Sen is a philosopher and economist who studied at the University of Calcutta and Trinity College, Cambridge. He held academic positions at Jadavpur University, the University of Delhi, the London School of Economics, and Harvard University.

Amber D. Carpenter is a scholar of philosophy and Buddhist studies who studied under M. M. McCabe and Verity Harte, among others. She has held posts at the University of York, University of St Andrews, and Yale-NUS College.

Amelia Hall is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who received her doctorate from the University of Oxford. She has held teaching appointments at Naropa University and Central Michigan University (both attested 2019).

Amin Sweeney was a scholar of linguistics who earned his doctorate at the University of London. He was a professor at Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (1970-1977) and chaired South and Southeast Asian Studies at UC Berkeley in 1998.
Amita Chatterjee is a philosopher and Indologist who served as a professor of philosophy at Jadavpur University (attested 1999 and 2009).
Amod Jayant Lele is a scholar of philosophy, religious studies, and Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at Harvard University under the supervision of Parimal G. Patil.

Amy Heller is an archaeologist and Tibetologist. She studied at Barnard College, INALCO, and the École Pratique des Hautes Études under Ariane Macdonald, and held posts at the CNRS, INALCO, and as a visiting professor at Rome and Sichuan Universities.

Amy Paris Langenberg is a scholar of Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Indology who completed her PhD at Columbia University and served as an assistant professor of religious studies at Eckerd College (~2014).

Amy Sims Miller is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She studied at Wesleyan University and completed her MA and PhD at the University of Virginia under David F. Germano, alongside studies with various traditional teachers.
